author: Warren
text:
Ladies and Gents,

Now, marketing has taught me a thing or two! The subject bar should of got your attention, wonder what you thought?

I have been thinking about my posts and how some of them are not powerful, it is hard to get my feeling and passion across with the written word.

Some of these posts could really hit home with a video or even audio.

How can i inspire you, how can you feel the pain i once had or the passion i have?

I want you to not only read it, but hear me and feel what i say.

I have decided to start adding some audio/video to my threads and in some replies to.

I want you to feed off that energy and take action. Feel that pain i had, and relate to it if it is where you are now.

But it is going to need a BIG shout out for it. I need all of you to vote, EVERY single one from moderators to Lurkers (Thats right i want YOU!, if you are hiding in the back ground, come forward i want to hear you?

Spread the word across this forum, make sure the votes roll in. I need to feel your energy, before i do this.

If you are not bothered, why should i?

IN the message body in need you to put " BIG shout out from (YOUR NAME)"

Let's do this!
